description: TRIAL (2026-09-25). Renovate runs alongside Dependabot and catalog-update.yml and opens nothing on its own: every update waits on the Dependency Dashboard for a maintainer to tick it.

Scope is the root workspaces.catalog only, the one set Dependabot cannot read. Renovate's bun manager does not extract Bun catalogs either (it handles pnpm and yarn catalogs only), so a JSONata custom manager finds them.
Switch-over steps and the known gap (a custom manager does not refresh bun.lock) are in docs/architecture/dependency-management.md, 'Renovate trial'.

customManagers.description: Bun workspaces.catalog in the root package.json; every entry is an npm package.

packageRules.description: Patch bumps travel together, as in .catalog-updaterc.json's all-patch-updates; the named groups below take precedence.
Same groups as .catalog-updaterc.json, so the two tools' PRs line up one to one during the trial.
